description:
Why does it seem like God is silent in our moments of need? Join this Bible Q & A with John Dinzey, James Rafferty, and Ricky Carter for answers from God's Word.

Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:


1. Why does it look like God is silent in our moments of need? 

2. Please explain what the Bible says about interracial marriage? 

3. Are all marriages between a man and a woman blessed by God? What if God didn't want you to marry that person but you, in ignorance, married them anyway? 

4. Can you explain Matthew 16:28? It says "some of you standing here right now will not die before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom." 

5. My question is regarding tithe and offerings. A lot of overseas workers I know who lived in a foreign country for many years give their tithe and offerings to their home country even though they don't attend that church anymore. Their reason is to help their church back home. As far as I know, we are to give our tithe and offerings to the church that we are currently attending because it is the church that nurtures us and our church family is now where we go. I find it confusing because those who give their tithe and offerings back home even if they are not there anymore give the reason they do so is that their church there will have a high return of tithes and many more people will be interested to visit because their church building is nice and big. What is the right thing to do? Does it matter or not as long as we return the tenth to the Lord? What does the Bible or our church say about this matter? Where should we pay our tithe and offerings?

6. When the righteous go up to meet Jesus in the clouds, what happens when they leave the earth? Do the planes crash if the pilot was righteous? Do cars crash if the drivers were righteous? What happens to the people that are left on earth? Do they die, do they still live, or what? The people left on earth are the unsaved, right? Please explain. What happens on earth when the righteous are called up to meet Jesus in the clouds?

7. How many opportunities did Satan have to be forgiven? Humans were told to forgive our brothers 70x7. So how and why was Satan totally cut off? 

8. If you commit sins again and again, does that mean the Holy Spirit has left you? 

9. What is the meaning of Isaiah 14:9 and Ezekiel 32:21? 

10. Can you please explain Revelation 5:8?
